mapper.select: SELECT t.parameter_id AS parameterId, t.parameter_code AS parameterCode, t.parameter_name AS parameterName, t.point_name AS pointName, t.point_type AS pointType FROM ( SELECT p.id AS parameter_id, p.code AS parameter_code, p.name AS parameter_name, dp.name AS point_name, dp.point_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY v.scheme_id, p.id, dp.name, dp.point_type ORDER BY v.id DESC ) AS rn FROM lm_inspection_scheme_version v INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_parameter sp ON sp.version_id = v.id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter p ON p.id = sp.parameter_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_data_point dp ON dp.version_id = v.id AND dp.parameter_id = sp.parameter_id AND dp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE v.scheme_id = #{schemeId} AND v.is_deleted = 0 ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.parameter_name ASC, t.parameter_id ASC, t.point_name ASC

SELECT p.id AS parameterId, p.code AS parameterCode, p.name AS parameterName, dp.name AS pointName, dp.point_type AS pointType FROM lm_inspection_scheme_parameter sp INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter p ON p.id = sp.parameter_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT sdp.parameter_id, sdp.name, sdp.point_type, MIN(sdp.id) AS min_id FROM lm_inspection_scheme_data_point sdp WHERE sdp.is_deleted = 0 AND sdp.version_id = #{versionId} GROUP BY sdp.parameter_id, sdp.name, sdp.point_type ) dp ON dp.parameter_id = sp.parameter_id WHERE sp.version_id = #{versionId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC, dp.min_id ASC

SELECT p.id AS parameterId, p.code AS parameterCode, p.name AS parameterName FROM lm_inspection_scheme_parameter sp INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter p ON p.id = sp.parameter_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.version_id = #{versionId} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT sdp.name FROM lm_inspection_scheme_data_point sdp WHERE sdp.version_id = #{versionId} AND sdp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sdp.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.id AS parameterId, p.code AS parameterCode, p.name AS parameterName FROM lm_inspection_scheme_version v INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_parameter sp ON sp.version_id = v.id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter p ON p.id = sp.parameter_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE v.scheme_id = #{schemeId} AND v.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT dp.name FROM lm_inspection_scheme_version v INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_data_point dp ON dp.version_id = v.id AND dp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE v.scheme_id = #{schemeId} AND v.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY dp.name, dp.point_type ORDER BY MIN(dp.id) ASC

SELECT ier.id, ier.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, ier.inspection_order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, ier.task_id AS taskId, ier.scheme_id AS schemeId, ier.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, ier.package_id AS packageId, ier.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, ier.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, ier.data_point_config_id AS dataPointConfigId, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ier.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ier.parameter_id AS parameterId, ier.parameter_code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.data_point_name AS dataPointName, ier.point_type AS pointType, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON ier.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ier.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE ier.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND ier.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ier.task_id, ier.data_point_id

SELECT ier.id, ier.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, ier.inspection_order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, ier.task_id AS taskId, ier.scheme_id AS schemeId, ier.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, ier.package_id AS packageId, ier.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, ier.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, ier.data_point_config_id AS dataPointConfigId, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ier.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ier.parameter_id AS parameterId, ier.parameter_code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.data_point_name AS dataPointName, ier.point_type AS pointType, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, t.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, t.owner_id AS ownerId, t.owner_name AS ownerName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, COALESCE(isp.standard_rule, sssp.standard_rule) AS standardRule, t.is_reportable AS isReportable, t.is_executable AS isExecutable, t.judged_result AS judgedResult, t.judged_time AS judgedTime, t.status AS status, t.judged_abnormal AS abnormal, t.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, t.reviewed_time AS reviewedTime, le.entry_time AS entryTime, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime, t.execute_method AS executeMethod FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON ier.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ier.parameter_id = ip.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp ON ier.parameter_config_id = isp.id AND isp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_stability_scheme_parameter sssp ON ier.parameter_config_id = sssp.id AND sssp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_task t ON t.id = ier.task_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ier2.task_id, MAX(COALESCE(ier2.update_time, ier2.create_time)) AS entry_time FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier2 WHERE ier2.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ier2.task_id ) le ON le.task_id = ier.task_id WHERE ier.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND ier.inspect_item_id = #{inspectItemId} AND ier.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ier.task_id, ier.data_point_id

SELECT DISTINCT ier.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ier.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON ier.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE ier.inspection_order_id = #{orderId} AND ier.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ier.inspect_item_id

SELECT ier.id, ier.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, ier.inspection_order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, ier.task_id AS taskId, ier.scheme_id AS schemeId, ier.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, ier.package_id AS packageId, ier.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, ier.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, ier.scheme_data_point_id AS dataPointConfigId, ier.original_data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ier.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ier.parameter_id AS parameterId, ier.parameter_code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.data_point_name AS dataPointName, ier.point_type AS pointType, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON ier.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ier.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE ier.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND (#{schemeVersionId} IS NULL OR ier.scheme_version_id = #{schemeVersionId}) AND ier.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ier.task_id, ier.data_point_id

SELECT t.id, t.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, t.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.name AS inspectItemName, t.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, t.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, t.parameter_id AS parameterId, ip.name AS parameterName, t.parameter_code AS parameterCode, t.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, t.is_executable AS isExecutable, t.execute_method AS executeMethod, t.is_reportable AS isReportable, t.status, t.judged_abnormal AS abnormal, t.judged_result AS judgedResult, t.judged_time AS judgedTime, t.test_time AS testTime, t.owner_id AS ownerId, t.owner_name AS ownerName, le.entry_time AS entryTime, t.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, t.reviewed_time AS reviewedTime, t.reviewed_abnormal_reason AS reviewRejectReason, t.assigner_id AS assignerId, t.assigner_name AS assignerName, t.assign_time AS assignTime, t.claim_time AS claimTime, t.complete_time AS completeTime, t.terminate_time AS terminateTime, t.terminate_reason AS terminateReason, t.return_reason AS returnReason, t.reject_reason AS rejectReason, t.remark AS remark FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON t.inspect_item_id = ii.id INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON t.parameter_id = ip.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ier.task_id, MAX(COALESCE(ier.update_time, ier.create_time)) AS entry_time FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier WHERE ier.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ier.task_id ) le ON le.task_id = t.id WHERE t.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status ='SAMPLE_AUDIT_PENDING' ORDER BY t.inspect_item_code ASC, t.parameter_code ASC

SELECT t.id, t.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, t.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.name AS inspectItemName, t.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, t.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, t.parameter_id AS parameterId, ip.name AS parameterName, t.parameter_code AS parameterCode, t.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, t.is_executable AS isExecutable, t.execute_method AS executeMethod, t.is_reportable AS isReportable, t.status, t.judged_abnormal AS abnormal, t.judged_result AS judgedResult, t.judged_time AS judgedTime, t.test_time AS testTime, t.owner_id AS ownerId, t.owner_name AS ownerName, le.entry_time AS entryTime, t.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, t.reviewed_time AS reviewedTime, t.reviewed_abnormal_reason AS reviewRejectReason, t.assigner_id AS assignerId, t.assigner_name AS assignerName, t.assign_time AS assignTime, t.claim_time AS claimTime, t.complete_time AS completeTime, t.terminate_reason AS terminateReason, t.return_reason AS returnReason, t.reject_reason AS rejectReason, t.remark AS remark FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON t.inspect_item_id = ii.id INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON t.parameter_id = ip.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ier.task_id, MAX(COALESCE(ier.update_time, ier.create_time)) AS entry_time FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier WHERE ier.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ier.task_id ) le ON le.task_id = t.id WHERE t.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY t.inspect_item_code ASC, t.parameter_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT ier.task_id AS taskId, ier.operator_id AS operatorId FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier WHERE ier.is_deleted = 0 AND ier.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND ier.task_id IN
#{id}

SELECT ier.id, t.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, t.id AS taskId, sv.scheme_id AS schemeId, io.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, sdp.package_id AS packageId, isi.id AS itemConfigId, isp.id AS parameterConfigId, sdp.id AS dataPointConfigId, sdp.data_point_id AS dataPointId, sdp.name AS dataPointName, sdp.point_type AS pointType, sdp.time_format AS timeFormat, sdp.date_style AS dateStyle, sdp.options AS optionsJson, sdp.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, sdp.parameter_id AS parameterId, ip.code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON t.inspection_order_id = io.id AND io.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_version sv ON io.scheme_version_id = sv.id INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp ON isp.version_id = io.scheme_version_id AND isp.id = t.parameter_config_id AND isp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_item isi ON isi.id = isp.item_config_id AND isi.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_data_point sdp ON sdp.version_id = io.scheme_version_id AND sdp.parameter_config_id = t.parameter_config_id AND sdp.inspect_item_id = t.inspect_item_id AND sdp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_entry_record ier ON ier.task_id = t.id AND ier.data_point_config_id = sdp.id AND ier.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON sdp.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON sdp.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sdp.id

SELECT ier.id, t.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, t.id AS taskId, ssv.scheme_id AS schemeId, io.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, NULL AS packageId, ssi.id AS itemConfigId, ssp.id AS parameterConfigId, ssdp.id AS dataPointConfigId, ssdp.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ssdp.name AS dataPointName, ssdp.point_type AS pointType, ssdp.time_format AS timeFormat, ssdp.date_style AS dateStyle, ssdp.options AS optionsJson, t.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ssdp.parameter_id AS parameterId, ip.code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON t.inspection_order_id = io.id AND io.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON io.scheme_version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_parameter ssp ON ssp.version_id = io.scheme_version_id AND ssp.id = t.parameter_config_id AND ssp.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_item ssi ON ssi.id = ssp.item_config_id AND ssi.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_data_point ssdp ON ssdp.version_id = io.scheme_version_id AND ssdp.parameter_config_id = t.parameter_config_id AND ssdp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_entry_record ier ON ier.task_id = t.id AND ier.data_point_config_id = ssdp.id AND ier.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON t.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ssdp.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ssdp.id

SELECT ier.id, ier.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, ier.inspection_order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, ier.task_id AS taskId, ier.scheme_id AS schemeId, ier.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, ier.package_id AS packageId, ier.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, ier.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, ier.scheme_data_point_id AS dataPointConfigId, ier.original_data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ier.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ier.parameter_id AS parameterId, ier.parameter_code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.data_point_name AS dataPointName, ier.point_type AS pointType, sdp.time_format AS timeFormat, sdp.date_style AS dateStyle, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON ier.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ier.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE ier.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND ier.parameter_id = #{parameterId} AND ier.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ier.data_point_id

SELECT DISTINCT t.id FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN lm_inspection_team_member itm ON t.inspect_item_id = itm.inspect_item_id INNER JOIN lm_inspection_team it ON itm.team_id = it.id WHERE itm.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND itm.is_deleted = 0 AND it.is_deleted = 0

SELECT ier.id, ier.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, ier.inspection_order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, ier.task_id AS taskId, ier.scheme_id AS schemeId, ier.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, ier.package_id AS packageId, ier.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, ier.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, ier.scheme_data_point_id AS dataPointConfigId, ier.original_data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ier.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ier.parameter_id AS parameterId, ier.parameter_code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.data_point_name AS dataPointName, ier.point_type AS pointType, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON ier.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ier.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE ier.scheme_data_point_id = #{dataPointConfigId} AND ier.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ier.task_id, ier.create_time

SELECT ier.id, ier.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, ier.inspection_order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, ier.task_id AS taskId, ier.scheme_id AS schemeId, ier.scheme_version_id AS schemeVersionId, ier.package_id AS packageId, ier.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, ier.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, ier.data_point_config_id AS dataPointConfigId, ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ier.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ier.parameter_id AS parameterId, ier.parameter_code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName,
ier.data_point_id AS dataPointId, ier.data_point_name AS dataPointName, ier.point_type AS pointType, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime, ier.operator_id AS operatorId, ier.operator_name AS operatorName, ier.is_abnormal AS abnormal, ier.remark, ier.create_time AS createTime, ier.update_time AS updateTime FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON ier.inspect_item_id = ii.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ier.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE ier.data_point_config_id = #{dataPointConfigId} AND ier.task_id = #{taskId} AND ier.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ier.create_time

SELECT DISTINCT sit.team_id FROM lm_inspection_scheme_item_teams sit INNER JOIN lm_inspection_team it ON sit.team_id = it.id INNER JOIN lm_inspection_team_member itm ON it.id = itm.team_id WHERE itm.user_id = #{userId} AND sit.is_deleted = 0 AND it.is_deleted = 0 AND itm.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT ssit.team_id FROM lm_stability_scheme_item_teams ssit INNER JOIN lm_inspection_team it ON ssit.team_id = it.id INNER JOIN lm_inspection_team_member itm ON it.id = itm.team_id WHERE itm.user_id = #{userId} AND ssit.is_deleted = 0 AND it.is_deleted = 0 AND itm.is_deleted = 0
